content: ⌊ DRAFT g In case a NV block configured in the NvM High Proxy is not connected to any NvM Low Proxy, the NvM High Proxy shall initialize the Nv RAM Block, with the default values given by NvMRomBlockDataAddress and / or NvMInitBlockCallback .
